title: Point interactions and singular solutions to semilinear elliptic equations
summary: We investigate the connection between semilinear elliptic PDEs with isolated singularities and stationary nonlinear Schrödinger equations with point interactions. In dimensions $d=2,3$, we establish a rigorous correspondence between their solutions, revealing two regimes depending on whether a boundary condition at the singularity can be imposed. This connection enables us to exploit operator-theoretic and variational methods that have not previously been applied to the study of isolated singularities.
